newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kawasaki Steel wins order from Brazil steel maker.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki Steel wins order from Brazil steel maker.

text.p: Kawasaki Steel Corp said on Tuesday that it had received an order from Brazilian steel maker Cia Acos Especiais Itabira - Acesita to build an electric-welded tube production facility.
The facility, with a production capacity of 2,000 tonnes per month, is expected to start operating in 1998, a Kawasaki Steel spokesman said.
The spokesman, however, declined to disclose the amount of the order.
Kawasaki Steel has been operating a 300-tonne-per-month electric-welded tube facility at one of its domestic plants since 1991. The tubes are mainly used to make car exhaust pipes.
